# Unenforceable universal (LOG010)

always/never attached to something that cannot be guaranteed. In the spec pack this is an error.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `log-universal-quantifier` |
| Family | logical |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | ISO |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

A universal claim bound to something the reader cannot actually guarantee. The model checks enforceability.

Bad:  Always return within 10 ms.
Good: Return within 10 ms for inputs under 1 KB.

Not a finding when the universal is genuinely enforceable or bounded.
